title: The Members list offers only this location's staff, including you
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user.
  • The Notifications page is open on the Tag groups tab.
  • An active location is selected.
  • Staff exist at the active location and at another location.
custom_steps:
1. Click the bell icon at the top right and open the Tag groups tab. Open the Members picker and confirm it offers only staff of the active location.
  2. Confirm you can include yourself (the picker offers you).
  3. Look for any staff from another location.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Members picker offers only staff who belong to the active location, and it offers you (you can include yourself).
  • The picker never offers staff from another location.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10249 (S6, Manage tag groups); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S6; design boards TagGroups/Modal; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R9: “The Members picker offers only staff who belong to the active location.”
  • S6-R30: “A user can include themselves in a tag group's members, and the Members picker offers them.”
  • S6-N8: “The picker never offers staff from another location.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
